expectations.text: Repository left unmodified (work done on copies)
Chapter is 3-15% shorter (a real pass, not a no-op or a rewrite)
At least 90% of sentences the author restored on 2 Oct are kept verbatim
expectations.evidence: 29/48 kept; changed: And importantly: does it beat simplification? | Perhaps the best response to an overloaded page is fewer things. | The system should have to earn its complexity against the possibility  | A society is not improved merely by hiring the best individual expert

expectations.text: Change list gives before/after measurements compared against a baseline from the author's own chapters
expectations.evidence: measurements.txt reports before/after for check-tells.py and a custom measure.py (contractions/1k 2.6->13.0, 'may'/1k 6.9->2.2, fragment runs 16->7, questions 5.0->2.2) with Chapter 4 shown as the author's baseline.

expectations.text: Every cut or recast in the change list has a stated reason
expectations.evidence: changes.md is organised by category with a reason per category, but many edits are not listed individually ('Also changed: L15, L29, L31, L105, L183'; contractions applied throughout; intensifiers trimmed). The 54KB diff rewrites nearly every sentence, including 19 of 48 author-restored lines (e.g. 'And importantly: does it beat simplification?' -> 'And, more important, does it beat simplification?'; 'Perhaps the best response...is fewer things' -> '...may be fewer things'), which have no stated reason, and the list falsely claims restored lines are 'kept word for word'.

expectations.text: No invented first-person experience, new facts or new claims added to the chapter
expectations.evidence: No invented experiences or new facts found in the diff; hedge removals mostly shift tone (e.g. 'Sami may read it...' -> 'Sami reads it...' inside an explicit 'If it works perfectly' hypothetical). The AUTHOR comment is kept and the note says 'No experiences were invented'.

expectations.text: Jokes and the chapter's comic lines survive the pass (none cut or flattened)
expectations.evidence: All jokes checked survive: PowerPoint theme 'earns its salary', RETURN_HESITANT_PERSON 'until retirement', 'resignation letter written in passive voice', 'junk drawer with tenure', and the configuration-matrix line kept as 'rebuilding the configuration matrix in brighter colors'.

notes: This is closer to a line-level rewrite than a de-LLM pass: almost every sentence is touched (contractions pushed to 13/1k, above the Ch 4 baseline), only 2.8% shorter, and 19 author-restored lines were altered against the author's recent decision. The change list's claim that restored lines were kept verbatim is false. The texture diagnosis (hedge stacking, Suppose/Imagine openers, fragment runs) is reasonable, but the register shift toward chatty could itself read as imposed.
